scope: ready lodging deep research reinforcement: toba-kisara-bettei-toki / 季さら別邸 刻
method: Existing Rakuten, Jalan, Relux, Ikkyu, Yahoo Travel, and Google-native counts were retained. Google Maps/Hotels was rechecked with Aside Browser. Tripadvisor, Tabelog, 4travel travelogues, Japanese blogs/Ameblo, and note individual bodies were added. Booking, Agoda, Trip.com, Trivago, Amimir, Korean web, and Naver were mapped but snippets/summaries were not counted as direct reviews.

direct_review_sampling_status.why_A: Additional direct bodies increased the sample from 256 to 285, then the old unlogged Google-native 20 line was replaced with a current Aside Browser author-logged Google-native 35 sample. Net total is 300 direct bodies, with 11 direct-body platforms and stratified Google/latest/low-rating/onsen-keyword coverage. Korean direct Naver remains a gap, but not a blocker for A after Google direct body recheck.
direct_review_sampling_status.next_after_A: Optional reinforcement: Naver Blog/Cafe direct Korean stay reports and Booking/Agoda/Trip.com individual bodies if they become stable.
